mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three months signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings declines, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in 3 months, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signal robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 105), a monthly decline in industrial production signals supply chain disruption that reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 105 and declines, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation that triggers anticipated monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.3% in a month, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates sustained consumer spending strength that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days in all regimes.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 105, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
